tests.name: One tap switches pending pinyin to literal English without losing committed Chinese

English mode uses native English punctuation and uppercase keys

Mode controls remain available without candidates and never overlap candidate targets
Repeated switching releases old input wrappers and old language callbacks are inert
Other language layouts and sensitive input fields retain the native keyboard
Switching while editing in the middle keeps all surrounding text
Chinese setup registers both languages even if the user previously selected another layout
